description: This file contains functions and data structures for building and exporting curriculum data, including importing external modules, defining types and interfaces for curriculum structures, and functions to generate curriculum JSON files for a learning platform.

methods.name: buildExtCurriculumDataV2
methods.description: Main function to generate curriculum data files, including parsing curriculum, challenge files, and scene assets.

methods.name: parseCurriculumData
methods.description: Parses curriculum data and writes superblock info, chapters, blocks, and challenges to files.

methods.name: buildChapterBasedCurriculum
methods.description: Builds and writes chapter-based curriculum JSON data.

methods.name: buildBlockBasedCurriculum
methods.description: Builds and writes block-based curriculum JSON data.

methods.name: buildChallengeFiles
methods.description: Generates challenge JSON files for each challenge in the curriculum.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Helper to write JSON data to a specified file path.

methods.name: getSubmitTypes
methods.description: Writes submit types data to a JSON file.

methods.name: getSceneAssets
methods.description: Writes scene assets data to a JSON file.
